title: Design review feedback
idea: A peer review is a second engineer reading your design against the requirements, and giving feedback you can turn into a specific change.
points: Share the requirements, the class diagram and the tests before the review.
Ask reviewers to trace one use case, such as booking a taken room.
Phrase comments as the chapter 3 review page shows: class, problem, fix.
Record each point as accept, discuss or decline, with a one-line reason.
